description: This source file provides functions to resolve and manage the execution of a command related to 'pi', including ensuring its runtime environment is properly materialized, possibly via npm package installation. It handles environment variables, path evaluation, and synchronization to manage a singleton command instance.

methods.name: resolveDocsPiCommand
methods.description: Resolves the command for executing 'pi', either from environment variables, system path, or by ensuring the runtime is materialized.

methods.name: shouldMaterializePiRuntime
methods.description: Determines if the 'pi' runtime should be materialized based on its real path.

methods.name: ensureMaterializedPiRuntime
methods.description: Ensures the 'pi' runtime is downloaded and installed locally if not already present.

methods.name: getMaterializedPiRuntimeDir
methods.description: Returns the directory path where the materialized 'pi' runtime is stored.

methods.name: getMaterializedPiPackageVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the package version for the materialized 'pi' runtime, defaulting if not set.
